hero.name: Marden Resende Andrade
hero.tagline: I build web applications end to end — REST APIs in Java/Spring Boot and interfaces in React/TypeScript. From QA I bring the habit of writing testable code and thinking about edge cases before shipping.

about.title: Who I am
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack developer focused on Java/Spring Boot on the back end and React/TypeScript on the front end. I started programming while studying Computer Science and quickly moved from theory into practice, building personal, academic and university-extension projects for real clients — from gathering requirements to delivery.

I started my career as a Java developer and today I work as a Mid-level QA Analyst at GFSIS, where I also take on development tasks in the same Java system. That combination gives me a full view of the software lifecycle: I reduced the bug rate per release and built my own QA platform, with AI generating test scenarios and Jira integration, now adopted by my team. Now I'm looking for a remote developer role, where that focus on quality turns into better code.

projects.title: Recent work
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects that show how I build and test software.

items.title: Student Management & Recurring Payments
items.description: Student, plan, subscription and payment management for a muay thai gym, built in a university-extension project for a real client. Hexagonal back-end with JWT auth, encrypted CPF, Flyway migrations and a scheduled job for overdue payments.

items.title: FinUp
items.description: Personal expense manager built in a university-extension project for a real client: JWT auth, password recovery by e-mail, installments, spending charts, Excel export and a Swagger-documented API. I worked on the back end, database and front-end integration.

items.title: Accounting Expert System
items.description: Expert system that guides a company through adaptive questions and produces a tax-regime and obligations report with recommendations, alerts, a local-AI summary (Llama 3 via Ollama) and PDF export. University-extension project with a real client.

items.title: Health Center Triage System
items.description: My undergraduate thesis (in progress): a web system that classifies patients by urgency level and automatically orders the care queue, helping health professionals prioritize the most severe cases.

items.title: Painel Faculdade
items.description: Academic organization platform: courses, assignments, exams, grades, spaced-repetition flashcards and an auto-generated study schedule, integrated with Google Classroom and Google Calendar. Full-stack monorepo in production.

items.title: QA Platform
items.description: A platform I built to centralize and document the tests I run as a QA analyst. It uses AI (Claude) to generate test scenarios and integrates with Jira — creating subtasks, marking them as done and more. Adopted by my team. Private code (internal use).

items.title: Atividade Atleta
items.description: Ticketing platform for races and sporting events, built with a friend and live in production for real organizers and athletes. Payments integrated with Mercado Pago, an organizer area and athlete profiles.
